correctness.rationale: For the exact set of 32 binary length-nine palindromes, use symmetric minimal suffix-prefix overlap shifts c_ij. Any circular containing word gives a tour of distinct chosen palindrome start positions, so its length bounds below a Hamiltonian-cycle overlap cost. Independently regenerated all 496 unordered pair shifts from 32 explicit palindromes, verified symmetric costs, sum of integer vertex potentials 81 and exactly seven positive edge deficits summing 20. Since a Hamiltonian cycle uses degree two at each vertex and any unordered edge at most once, its cost is >=2*81-20=142. Independently scanned all 134 non-wrapping windows in the supplied 142-character binary witness and found all 32 distinct palindromes; thus linear and circular minima both equal 142. This is a complete finite dual certificate, not solver optimality or partial search.
